page: Microsoft Azure E128s_v6 is a high-capacity, memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Intel x86_64 architecture and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This allocation supports heavy multithreaded processing alongside extensive working memory reserves, operating without CPU oversubscription.

The server does not include integrated local disk storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options. It supports Azure Premium Storage to deliver predictable input and output performance for persistent data volumes. Hardware acceleration is not present on this instance, with zero GPUs provisioned. Additionally, the instance configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured virtual network gateways or secondary addressing for external connectivity.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the E128s_v6 enables extensive workload consolidation by providing high memory density within a single node. The absence of local solid-state drives reduces hardware footprint costs, shifting the operational storage budget strictly to external attached volumes based on application requirements. This profile is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise environments, including massive in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes, memory-heavy enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale analytic data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure E128s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an Intel x86_64 architecture processor. Running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 128 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 1024 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The hardware setup does not include local disk storage, depending entirely on remote block storage solutions such as Azure Premium Storage for operating systems and database storage. No dedicated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned with this profile. From a resource perspective, the high proportion of memory relative to CPU scale offers efficient consolidation for workloads demanding extensive RAM without paying for unnecessary hardware accelerators. The instance is suited for hosting large in-memory databases, enterprise-scale caching layers, distributed analytics engines, and comprehensive transaction processing systems.
